parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
 'contas', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.data) FROM (
   SELECT t.description AS descricao, t.date AS data, t.paid AS pago, round(t.amount_cents/100.0,2) AS valor,
          a.name AS conta, c.name AS categoria, t.updated_at AS atualizado_em
   FROM organizze.transactions t
   LEFT JOIN organizze.accounts a ON a.id=t.account_id
   LEFT JOIN organizze.categories c ON c.id=t.category_id
   WHERE t.credit_card_id IS NULL AND t.amount_cents < 0 AND t.oposite_transaction_id IS NULL
     AND ((t.date BETWEEN current_date-3 AND current_date+1) OR (t.paid=false AND t.date BETWEEN current_date-30 AND current_date))
 ) x),'[]'::json),
 'faturas_cartao', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(y ORDER BY y.vencimento) FROM (
   SELECT cc.name AS cartao, i.date AS vencimento, i.closing_date AS fechamento, round(i.amount_cents/100.0,2) AS valor_fatura,
          round(i.payment_amount_cents/100.0,2) AS valor_pago, round(i.balance_cents/100.0,2) AS saldo
   FROM organizze.credit_card_invoices i JOIN organizze.credit_cards cc ON cc.id=i.credit_card_id
   WHERE i.date BETWEEN current_date-3 AND current_date+3
 ) y),'[]'::json),
 'hoje', current_date
) AS organizze

parameters.content:
## Brief Matinal
Dias úteis 06:30, pulando feriados nacionais, locais e folgas. Coleta Organizze, Gmail, Calendar, TickTick, RSS e previsão do tempo e envia ao **brief-worker** (claude -p + edge-tts), que publica o episódio no feed privado.

Feriados locais/folgas: edite as constantes em *Calendário útil (feriados)*. Cidade da previsão: lat/lon em *Previsão do tempo*. Rode pelo *Teste manual* para gerar um episódio [Teste] fora do horário. Feeds: edite *Lista de feeds RSS*.
